appDescription: A family and friends location sharing app that guides the car to people for pickups, shares car locations with people or groups for a limited time, and shares a destination with a group so everyone's navigation goes to the same place.

function.name: PICKUP
function.description: Start or stop a pickup by navigating to a family member's or friend's live location, tell how far the person is, or pick up several people in the order the driver says and then go to a final destination. When a faster order exists, the app asks whether to change it; the driver's answer is sent back with action accept_order or keep_order.

action.description: start / stop a pickup, status to report the person's distance, accept_order when the driver agrees to the recommended faster pickup order, keep_order when the driver wants to keep the original order.

memberName.description: Name or relationship of the person, as the driver calls them in the family or friend list.

memberNames.description: Names or relationships of several people to pick up, in the order the driver said them.

pinnedName.description: The person the driver wants to pick up first no matter what.

destinationName.description: Final destination after picking everyone up, such as home or Gangneung.

function.name: SHARE_LOCATION
function.description: Share the car's location with a person or a group for a limited time, or share the current navigation destination (or the car's current position as a meeting point) with a group so members can navigate there.

targetName.description: Name of the person or group to share with. Destinations can be shared only with a group.

shareType.description: What to share: 'location' for the car's live location (default), 'current_destination' for the destination currently set in the navigation, 'car_position' to share where the car is now as a meeting point.

durationMinutes.description: How long to share the car's location, in minutes, up to 1440. Not used for destinations.

untilEndOfToday.description: True to share only until the end of today.

function.name: STOP_LOCATION_SHARING
function.description: Turn off location sharing that the driver has turned on, for one person or group, or for a whole list.

targetName.description: Name of one person or group to stop sharing with.

category.description: Which list to stop sharing with when no single person or group is named.
